notes: The peers write the first terminal and trailing frames together, then send the new result after the second create.
The complete-frame pairs use one upgrade, two creates and zero SSE POSTs. The cached modes send one incremental item on the second create.
The response after retirement is sent on a fresh socket with two full input items and no previous_response_id.
The paired result covers input read at pooled acquisition. Attribution of late data that first becomes readable after the idle check is a separate open case.
